description: This is a Java class defining a custom Android layout named ExpandingLayout. It extends RelativeLayout to enable a fade effect when a cell expands or collapses, by managing its height during measurement and size change events.

classes.name: ExpandingLayout
classes.description: Custom RelativeLayout for expandable cells with animated height adjustment and size change notifications.

methods.name: ExpandingLayout
methods.description: Constructors initializing the ExpandingLayout with different attribute inputs.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Overrides the measuring process to set a maximum height when expanded.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Overrides size change handling to record height and notify a listener.

methods.name: getExpandedHeight
methods.description: Returns the stored expanded height of the layout.

methods.name: setExpandedHeight
methods.description: Sets the expanded height for the layout.

methods.name: setSizeChangedListener
methods.description: Assigns a listener to be notified when the size of the layout changes.
